correctness.rationale: The equality P10 S5=H/(1-q^5040)^10 is exact by finite geometric sums. Two independent exact polynomial arithmetic algorithms compute ALL 50412 coefficients of H with precisely five zero positions 0,1,2,26,30; b(n)>0 outside 26,30 follows from positivity of H at every residue shifted by +5040 and from the positive denominator. The omitted positive product tail has q^21 coefficient at least one and fills indices 26 and 30 using b(5)=1 and b(9)=3. The underlying first coefficients also match independent signed partition enumeration. There is no extrapolation from finite sampling of the infinite target.

value.rationale: This proves the first genuinely new truncation N=5 after the initial N=1,2 lengths in a specific explicit 2026 conjecture, addressing strict positivity of infinitely many coefficients. The finite degree-50411 computation is a complete certificate for an infinite problem via a nontrivial rational-function factorization, not a numerical search cutoff. It isolates and repairs exactly two exceptional early coefficients using a positive-tail factor, and gives a reusable positivity-certificate strategy for future truncations. Other N remain open.
